tech.detail: 13269 link annotations for 12385 links in the source

coverage.where: w01, w03, w27, hsw01, d0101, d0111, d0502, d0831, goals, prices, routines, mm01
coverage.note: Every week shot has Content to post and Follow up. Every day shot has Calls and emails and Orders to send. Year plan, Price check, Business routines and Money month pages exist and were screenshotted.

coverage.where: year, m01-m12, w01-w53, d0101-d1231 (page_modules + PDF link graph)
coverage.note: 481 pages: 12 months, 53 weeks, 365 day pages. Every year-page date links to its day (365 links). The link graph reaches all 481 pages from the cover and no link points to a missing destination. The brief said 52 weeks; the build has 53, and the listing says 53.

coverage.where: listing.description (Works with)
coverage.note: One PDF. The listing names Goodnotes, Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Adobe Acrobat Reader and says no subscription is needed. The links are plain internal GoTo links (no JS, no forms, no external URIs). I could not test the file in the apps themselves.

coverage.where: all shots; PDF font list
coverage.note: Calm ivory pages with clear headings and wide writing room. Embedded fonts are only LibreBaskerville (Bold, Italic) and Jost (Regular, Medium, SemiBold). The PDF has 0 raster images, so everything is vector.

coverage.where: start, linktest, index
coverage.note: Start here has 4 numbered steps, Setup check has 3 test buttons and a fix list, and Contents has 11 section cards plus all 14 months. Week and day layouts are the same in every shot.

coverage.where: m01, m07, hs11 (Launches and content); w01/w03/w27/hsw01 (Content to post); content, content2
coverage.note: Content slots appear on the month and week pages. There are 2 Content ideas pages: content is screenshotted, content2 exists in page_modules and is linked from content.

coverage.where: listing.description lines 1-3; mm01; prices; week shots
coverage.note: The first lines say who it is for (one-person businesses, makers, Etsy sellers, service providers) and that it is not a business plan workbook, not a printable and not made to order. Money month, Price check, Content to post and Follow up are all present.

coverage.where: listing.description; photo-10-ph10_inside.jpg
coverage.note: Listing says 481 pages and 13.3 MB. The PDF has 481 pages and is 13,309,452 bytes. Per-type counts match page_modules (53 weeks, 365 days, 14 Money months, 12 habit trackers, 9 head-start weeks). Also stated: one landscape PDF, Oct 26 2026 to Dec 31 2027, Monday start. ph10 shows Contents.

coverage.where: listing (first FAQ line, What you get); start step 1
coverage.note: One PDF, no zip. The first FAQ line and Start here step 1 both say to download in a web browser because the Etsy app cannot download files. File size 13.3 MB is stated.

coverage.where: mm01, goals, prices, routines, m01h; photo-05-ph5_plan.jpg
coverage.note: The pages are all there: Money months for Nov/Dec 2026 and all of 2027, a Year plan with Q1-Q4 ticks, Price check, Routines, 12 habit trackers and content slots. But ph5 is not a close-up as the brief requires: it shows both pages whole and shrunk side by side, so the column headers are tiny. Only ph3 is a close-up.

coverage.where: listing; PDF link graph
coverage.note: Exact count (481) is in the listing. Over 13,269 internal links, 0 point to a missing destination. All 481 pages can be reached from the cover, and 480 are within 2 taps of Contents.

coverage.where: PDF (768x576 pt = 1024x768 px, 0 images, embedded subset fonts); photo-10-ph10_inside.jpg; listing
coverage.note: Vector pages with embedded OFL fonts at iPad landscape size. ph10 has a large zoomed crop of the day page that shows the text is sharp. The listing says pages are sized for screens, not letter/A4. The 'Dec 2026' tab on head-start pages runs to the page edge (see visual).

coverage.where: start step 3; listing (Good to know, FAQ); goals/prices/mm01/d0111
coverage.note: Step 3 says to use the app's text box tool on any line or table row. The listing says it is not a fillable form and not a Word or Canva template. Row height measured from the shots is about 30 px (goals, prices) and about 33 px (money, schedule).

coverage.where: start (4 steps + Tip); linktest; photo-07-ph7_start.jpg
coverage.note: The Tip reads 'Each Monday, one week page. Each month end, one Money month.' Setup check is linked from Start here step 2. The week and day layouts repeat. ph7 shows Start here and Setup check.

coverage.where: linktest (Nothing happened?); start; listing FAQ
coverage.note: The fix list has 3 real fixes (pen off, open in a PDF app, re-import unconverted) plus a 4th line, 'Still stuck? Message us on Etsy and we will help'. No reply-time promise. Start here covers download, apps, writing and typing, and the listing FAQ repeats these answers.

coverage.where: all shots; PDF link graph
coverage.note: The top bar (Home, Year, Goals, Prices, Content, Notes, Money) and the right-edge month tabs are on every shot. Trails: month 'Year / January', week 'January / Week 1', day 'January / Week 3'. Start here maps the top bar. All pages are within 2 taps of Contents (verified). On head-start pages, Nov/Dec 2027 tabs are swapped for Nov/Dec 2026 (see visual).

coverage.where: listing (Works with); start step 1
coverage.note: Apps are listed by device (iPad; Android; Chromebook, Windows and Mac). The listing says no Microsoft Word and no subscription are needed. Start step 1 repeats the app list per device.

coverage.where: mm01, mmhs11; m01/m07/hs11 Money month chip (links to mm01/mm07/mmhs11)
coverage.note: Has money in by source and money out by cost type, each with Planned and Actual columns, plus totals, profit, orders or clients, best seller, what worked and one change for next month. There are 14 pages. Each month page links to its own Money month.

coverage.where: start, linktest, year (Starting in 2026? Head start), hs11, hsw01
coverage.note: 4 steps, and step 4 covers both an Oct-Dec 2026 buyer and a 2027 buyer. Setup check buttons jump to a month, the year and Contents. 2 head-start months and 9 weeks start Mon Oct 26 and lead into w01 (Dec 28).

coverage.where: routines; m01h; m01/m07 Habit tracker chip
coverage.note: Routines cover every day, week, month and quarter, including send orders, batch content, pay fees, tax money aside and review prices. Each month has a habit tracker (14 blank rows, 31 days) linked from its month page.

coverage.where: goals, prices
coverage.note: Year plan has 16 rows: Goal, Why it matters, First step and Q1-Q4 tick boxes. Price check has 18 rows: Product or service, Cost to make, Fees and shipping, Your time, Price and Profit each.

coverage.where: all shots; PDF fonts
coverage.note: Warm ivory paper and charcoal ink. Month tabs step from sand to taupe. Habit circles are taupe. Buttons are solid charcoal. Field labels are italic Baskerville and body text is Jost. No florals, foil or photos. The sand bar is present on the cover, Contents and Start here, but sits flush against the top edge.

visual.issue: Head-start pages show the right-edge tabs as Jan-Oct (2027) followed by 'Nov 2026' and 'Dec 2026'. The 2026 months sit after October 2027, so the order is wrong. Nov and Dec 2027 tabs are missing from these pages, and the 'Dec 2026' label runs down to the bottom edge of the page.
visual.where: hs11, hsw01, mmhs11 (all head_start and mmhs pages)

visual.issue: The top-bar 'Money' button (mapped as 'Month end' on Start here) always opens January 2027 (mm01) from every page. A buyer in November 2026 or July 2027 who taps Money lands on the wrong month and has to use the month page's Money month chip instead.
visual.where: top bar, all pages (link target mm01)

visual.issue: ph3 crop stops before the Money out Total row and leaves out the right column. Its points still claim 'totals and profit' and 'Best seller and one change next month', none of which is in frame (r013, r005).

ph5, ph6, ph7, ph8 and ph9 each show two whole pages shrunk side by side. Column headers, fix-list text, year-calendar dates and the Contents help box are tiny at Etsy zoom, so these break r013 (show the useful part large, not a whole page shrunk). ph5 was also promised as a close-up.
ph2 and ph4 show the whole page at about 55% width with a large empty band above it, so the page labels are small.
ph10's third bullet sits alone on a line and crowds the 'Contents' caption below it. The 'January 11' crop cuts off the J descender at the card edge.
The large 'J' heading descender sticks out past the left page margin (about x=62 vs the 78 px margin) on January and July headings.
The Thursday date number on week pages sits against the card's right padding, and '14' looks clipped.
A single week chip ('Week 5', 'Week 31') wraps alone onto a second row on month pages.
The sand motif bar sits flush against the top edge of the page at top right, so it reads as a clipped stray element.
The Setup check eyebrow repeats the title ('Setup check' over 'Setup check').
There are some empty areas: a band between the month buttons and the help box on Contents, the bottom of the Year plan card, and the lower-left of Setup check (r006).
The head-start week Oct 26 to Nov 1 is filed under 'November 2026' even though its Thursday (Oct 29) is in October (r008). There is no October page, so the impact is minor.
